tasks.subject: Task 1: Scaffold the boh-admin Vite project
tasks.description:
Full details in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-admin-webapp-v0.md (Task 1).

**Goal:** A building, linting, testable Vite + React + TypeScript project in `boh-admin/`, wired with the `@/` alias, Vitest, and prettier, and ignored by the root repo's Jest/ESLint.

**Files:**
- Create: `boh-admin/` via `npm create vite@latest boh-admin -- --template react-ts`
- Create: `boh-admin/src/test/setup.ts`, `boh-admin/src/App.test.tsx`
- Delete: `boh-admin/src/App.css`, `boh-admin/src/assets/react.svg`, `boh-admin/public/vite.svg`
- Modify: root `package.json` (jest testPathIgnorePatterns + "/boh-admin/"), root `eslint.config.js` (ignores + "boh-admin/*")

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `npm run test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` all pass inside `boh-admin/`
- [ ] `@/` alias resolves in app code and tests
- [ ] Root `npm run lint` and `npm test` unaffected, do not descend into boh-admin

**Verify:** `cd boh-admin && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build` then `cd .. && npm run lint && npm test`

**Steps:** scaffold template; add deps (@supabase/supabase-js @tanstack/react-query react-router-dom clsx tailwind-merge; dev: vitest jsdom @testing-library/* @types/node prettier); replace vite.config.ts (alias, vitest jsdom+globals+setup, test.env dummy VITE_SUPABASE_*); tsconfig.app.json paths+types; package.json scripts (test/typecheck) + prettier block copied from mobile app; src/test/setup.ts imports jest-dom/vitest; strip boilerplate, minimal App.tsx + smoke test; root ignores; verify; commit. Exact file contents are in the plan doc.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["boh-admin/vite.config.ts", "boh-admin/tsconfig.app.json", "boh-admin/package.json", "boh-admin/src/test/setup.ts", "boh-admin/src/App.tsx", "boh-admin/src/App.test.tsx", "package.json", "eslint.config.js"], "verifyCommand": "cd boh-admin && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["boh-admin lint/typecheck/test/build all pass", "@/ alias resolves in app and tests", "root lint and jest ignore boh-admin"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Admin portal migration — staff RLS, grants, course-content bucket
tasks.description:
Full details in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-admin-webapp-v0.md (Task 3) - the complete SQL is there.

**Goal:** One migration giving staff write access to course structure and the whitelist, staff visibility into Reach Out DMs, reply-as-Tarryn inserts, and the `course-content` storage bucket.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/20260701000001_admin_portal.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `supabase db reset` applies all migrations cleanly
- [ ] pg_policies shows 7 new public policies + 3 storage policies (ilike '%staff%' returns 10 rows)
- [ ] Table grants added: insert/update/delete on courses, course_sections, lessons, lesson_resources, course_whitelist to authenticated (RLS alone is NOT enough in this repo - see 20260629000004_grants.sql history)
- [ ] No duplicate policies for announcements/moderation (staff already have those in the initial schema)

**Verify:** `supabase db reset` then `psql "postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres" -c "select schemaname, policyname from pg_policies where policyname ilike '%staff%' order by 1, 2;"` -> 10 rows

**Steps:** write migration per plan doc: is_staff_user(uid) security-definer helper; `for all` staff-write policies on the five course-structure tables (mirrors announcements_write pattern); grants; direct_messages_staff_select (staff participant); direct_messages_staff_send_as_tarryn (sender must be role tarryn); course-content bucket public=true + three staff-only storage.objects policies; apply locally; verify policies and grants via psql; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/migrations/20260701000001_admin_portal.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase db reset && psql \"postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres\" -c \"select schemaname, policyname from pg_policies where policyname ilike '%staff%' order by 1, 2;\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["db reset applies cleanly", "10 staff policies present", "insert/update/delete grants on the five course tables", "no duplicate announcement/moderation policies"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

EXECUTION NOTE (2026-07-02): per user instruction the migration was applied to the live prod Supabase project (not local db reset). Verified via `supabase db push` (applied cleanly) and `supabase migration list` showing 20260701000001 local|remote.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Supabase client, database types, and AuthProvider
tasks.description:
Full details in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-admin-webapp-v0.md (Task 4) - complete component and test code is there.

**Goal:** A typed Supabase web client and an AuthProvider that resolves the session plus users.role, exposing status `loading | signed-out | not-staff | staff`.

**Files:**
- Create: `boh-admin/src/lib/supabase.ts`, `boh-admin/src/lib/queryClient.ts`
- Create: `boh-admin/src/types/database.types.ts` (cp from root `src/types/database.types.ts`)
- Create: `boh-admin/src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx`, `boh-admin/.env.example`
- Modify: `boh-admin/src/vite-env.d.ts` (typed ImportMetaEnv)
- Test: `boh-admin/src/providers/AuthProvider.test.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] No session -> signed-out; staff session -> staff with role; non-staff session -> not-staff AND supabase.auth.signOut() called
- [ ] not-staff status survives the sign-out null-session event (functional setState guard)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with copied Database types

**Verify:** `cd boh-admin && npx vitest run src/providers` -> 3 tests pass

**Steps:** TDD - write the 3 tests first (vi.hoisted mocks for getSession/onAuthStateChange/signOut/from...single), verify fail, then implement AuthProvider (getSession + onAuthStateChange with setTimeout defer; role query on users; set not-staff BEFORE signOut so the null event preserves it; useAuth hook throws outside provider). Exact code in plan doc.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["boh-admin/src/lib/supabase.ts", "boh-admin/src/lib/queryClient.ts", "boh-admin/src/types/database.types.ts", "boh-admin/src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx", "boh-admin/src/providers/AuthProvider.test.tsx", "boh-admin/.env.example", "boh-admin/src/vite-env.d.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd boh-admin && npx vitest run src/providers", "acceptanceCriteria": ["signed-out/staff/not-staff resolution correct", "not-staff survives sign-out event", "typecheck passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
